source_evidence: Player exact 'continue' after completed D321 watch handoff. Travel resumes west with carter, no new pursuit or custody outcome. D321 night skip under one encounter/day, D322 mandatory quiet after two successive encounter days; no fabricated rolls. D321 and D322 consume3 ration person-days+4 feed units per full day (9→3,12→4), quiet exposed wilderness nights qualify short rests and +1 weighted LR each. V MP and Action Surge restore once at first qualifying rest; no missing HP, Psi, HD or other resources to restore, no Cirren slot recovery or Fenar Rage recovery, LR2/6. Routine Tamsin stone exchanges as standing instruction, no specific administration outcome. D323 ordinary maintained trade road with fixed day15 threshold and local candidates before visible genuine Python roll: batch3bd322a40a24726bc3fb7b39b8ff0666 d10031, no daytime encounter, no D323 night roll yet. Reach routine small market settlement by late afternoon per carter's own route familiarity; not a newly named mapped city or preexisting secret quest site. Market ordinary ration/feed prices consistent with D314 prior purchase6 rations+8 feed3gp4sp, offer 9+12=5gp1sp for three additional days, no automatic V expenditure. G1 normal commercial route and independent merchant objectives consistent with political geography; G2 ordinary travel, optional purchase or alternate provisioning, no forced quest; G3 actual travel rules/caps/roll and supplies/rest, no new prize or confrontation. D323~16:00, ordinary market settlement on maintained Ossent westbound coach route toward Orsaven, reached with wool merchant. D321 continued after watch handoff; no D321 night random roll (day encounter already consumed). D322 mandatory quiet day/night after consecutive D320/321 encounter days, no roll, streak reset. Both nights at ordinary exposed road camps qualify uninterrupted wilderness Short Rests; V MP6→7/7, ActionSurge0→1/1 after first, Cirren CD full, no spell slot or Rage restoration; weighted LR0→2/6, no full LR. D321/D322 full-day provision debits9→3 ration person-days,12→4 feed units, D323 full-day debit not yet charged. D323 ordinary trade road day15 threshold, genuine d10031 quiet, no night roll yet. Planned eight-day leg D317–324, encounter days2/5; expected arrival Orsaven D324 if no further delay, not guaranteed. Carter independently points out a routine market where three days of supplies (9 ration units at5sp each,12 feed units at5cp each) available for5gp1sp, no purchase authorized or made; optional different quantity. Current supplies one day before D323 evening charge, need at least one more day for D324. V purse3197gp4sp6cp; acquired raid gear stowed, no sale/appraisal. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots, no active spells; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive, Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40; Mara, merchant, vehicles/horses healthy. Routine Tamsin contact on D322/D323, no new estate outcomes assumed. Captain/veteran remain alive when handed to watch D321, no subsequent custody outcome received; five fugitives unpursued. Diplomatic sealed packet and credentials V-held, Crown intel remaining300+1300, Coris300/800, Kestrel evidence unchanged. Elara remains Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Await V resupply quantity or alternate action before remaining road leg.
